# KALM Collective

KALM Collective is a South African retail storefront for KS Active, KALM Move, KALM Outdoor, KALM Wellness and KALM Home.

## Primary pages

- https://kalmcollective.co.za/
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/brands
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/new-in
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/activewear
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/wellness
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/home
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/outdoor
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/sale

## Product information

Product pages provide current descriptions, colour options, pricing and availability. KALM Outdoor accessory concepts marked coming soon are not purchasable. Product availability and prices may change.

## Crawling

Machine-readable discovery files are available at /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml. Access is subject to the crawler's own robots policy and does not guarantee indexing or AI inclusion.
